criteria.requirement: Add cssselect.formstates.FormStateTranslator(HTMLTranslator) supporting static :required and :optional. Eligible controls are select, textarea and input except hidden/range/color/button/submit/reset/image, with missing/unknown input type behaving as text and ASCII-insensitive type values. State is based on required attribute presence; disabled does not change this declaration state. The two states partition only eligible controls, not arbitrary nodes. Support unnamespaced HTML and XHTML namespace, excluding foreign same-name elements, and preserve all inherited translator APIs and GenericTranslator unsupported behavior.
